data.rationale: The proposed workflow gets the first 11 steps in the right order (From, To, date, passengers/class, Confirm) but omits the final "Show flights" and "Select fare" steps. It also hardcodes Colombo, New York, 24 June 2023 and the passenger/cabin choices, so none of the varying inputs (origin, destination, date, passengers, cabin) are parameterized, which makes it a replay of one session rather than a reusable automation.
